name: za-labour-law-advisor
description: Worker-side strategic analysis, legal text auditing and document drafting for any South African employment dispute under the BCEA, NMWA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, UIA/UIC Act, Prescription Act and SARS rules, CCMA and bargaining council practice, with sector modules for the MEIBC Main Collective Agreement and MIBFA benefit funds.
